rules.justification: Linear static solve of a 3x3x3 Kuhn Tet4 cube (192 DOFs before Dirichlet): oracle MUMPS (parallel, centralised analysis), port faer LU centralised on rank 0 (D-040); both backward stable (backward error <= ~10 u). The element-level assembly is bitwise (same partition, same ghost order) but the distributed K is summed over ranks in a different order by the two backends. Measured max rel difference 1.9e-16 at 1 and 2 ranks: a >= 5000x margin. Conditioning (computed by crates/akantu-solid/tests/par_static_conditioning.rs): K restricted to the 144 free DOFs (z = 0 clamped) has cond2 = 4.076e2 (lambda_max 2.8126, lambda_min 6.9004e-3; power and inverse iteration on the dense matrix assembled by the port at 1 rank, par_static_conditioning.rs; dense symmetric eigenvalues of the same matrix, parallel_oracle.rs::smm_static_cube_n3_tolerance_bound_inputs: 4.076e2); normwise backward errors ||f - K u||2 / (||K||2 ||u||2 + ||f||2), residuals in double-double: 4.02e-17 (port, faer), 3.74e-17 and 4.22e-17 (aarch64 oracle MUMPS solutions of np1 and np2, against the same K; 3.62e-17 and 3.82e-17 for the x86_64 goldens). A-priori bound on the max-norm relative difference of two solutions (each within 2 cond2 eta of the exact solution, Higham Thm 7.2, so the difference within 2 cond2 (eta1 + eta2)): sqrt(144) * 2 * cond2 * (eta_port + eta_oracle) <= 12 * 2 * 407.6 * (4.02e-17 + 4.22e-17) = 8.06e-13 < 1e-12 (the worst pair, np2; the np1 pair: 7.59e-13; with the x86_64 goldens the worst pair gives 7.66e-13); measured 1.912e-16 (np1 and np2; x86_64 goldens: <= 1.920e-16).
rules.evidence: 2026-11-11: crates/akantu-solid/tests/parallel_oracle.rs (smm_static_cube_n3_matches_the_oracle; measured 1.912e-16 at 1 and 2 ranks against the aarch64 values (now the variants/aarch64-auto of the three cases), x86_64 identical; against the x86_64 goldens (OPENBLAS_CORETYPE=Haswell, D-073, on an x86_64 host): 1.912e-16 at 1 rank, 1.912e-16 / 1.920e-16 on the two ranks of np2); bound inputs computed by two committed tests: parallel_oracle.rs::smm_static_cube_n3_tolerance_bound_inputs (np1 pair, bound asserted < 1e-12) and par_static_conditioning.rs::pa2_04_static_cube_conditioning_supports_the_tolerance (np1 and np2 pairs, worst-pair bound asserted < 1e-12 and measured <= bound; backward errors reported, not asserted)

rules.justification: Exact, in the form of the D-039 amendment: upstream's getExternalWork() is allReduce(_sum) of the ranks' accumulated works. The association of MPI_Allreduce observed for the oracle's Open MPI 5.0.7 (one node, default MCA) depends on the rank count (rank order at 2 and 3 ranks, pairwise at 4 and 8, mixed at 5 to 7); at 8 ranks it differs from the port's rank-order fold by one ulp per component for this case. Probe version 2 records each rank's work (final/external_work_rank). The port's per-rank work is compared bitwise with the recorded one; its global value must equal the recorded value bitwise or, under the rank-ordered policy, the rank-order fold of the recorded per-rank works exactly; the recorded value must equal the fold of the recorded per-rank works in the observed association; under ReductionPolicy::NativeMpi only the bitwise value is accepted (an observation for this Open MPI build and one node, not a cross-implementation promise, D-039). No tolerance.
rules.evidence: 2026-11-13: crates/akantu-ntn-contact/tests/par_ntn/mod.rs external_work_matches (ntn_parallel.rs local world 1/2/4/8; mpi_ntn real MPI 1/2/4/8 x3, both policies); upstream's eight per-rank works equal the port's bitwise and its MPI_Allreduce equals their pairwise sum bitwise. The recorded global value is checked against the fold of the recorded per-rank works in the observed association (par_common::oracle_allreduce_fold), in the local world (fast tier) and under real MPI; mutation (the rank-order fold instead) fails at 8 ranks.
